title: Presentations
slide_intent: Teach how a presentation changes pace between an opening, divider, content slide and chart. The audience needs to recognize the level of information before reading the details.
strategic_value: The brand can remain visible across a talk while a quiet white layout gives evidence and explanation the space they need.
demonstration: Nine examples form a three-by-three grid on pink. Bright covers and section dividers sit alongside white text, image and chart slides and a photographic closing statement.
practical_value: Use a divider treatment for a section change, a quieter page for dense copy, and a dedicated chart layout when the data is the main evidence.

content_islands.name: Title and divider examples
content_islands.spec: Keep the image-bearing covers and headline-led dividers at comparable thumbnail sizes so their role is apparent.

content_islands.name: Content examples
content_islands.spec: Show text, photography, chart and closing examples in the same three-column grid. Retain gutters so the slide boundaries read clearly.
